Loads the arrangements, applies the exclusions, and builds the adult
reference. Nothing here is an analysis. Everything downstream reads
`analysis_sample.rds` and never touches the raw files again.

```{r}
#| label: setup
source(here::here("setup.R"))
```

# Children

```{r}
#| label: load-children
children <- load_placements(CHILD_DIR, CHILD_LABEL)

tibble(n_children = n_distinct(children$participant_id),
       n_trials = nrow(distinct(children, participant_id, category, trial)),
       n_items = nrow(children)) %>% show_all()

children %>%
  count(category, name = "items") %>%
  arrange(match(category, DOMAIN_LEVELS)) %>% show_all()

# Photographs whose filename matches no known concept. Expect none.
untagged <- children %>% filter(is.na(category)) %>% count(image_name)
if (nrow(untagged)) show_all(untagged) else cat("All photographs tagged.\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: comprehension
# Practice trial 2: four of the five foods scored on nearest neighbour.
comprehension <- score_comprehension(attr(children, "raw"))

comprehension %>% count(n_ok, name = "children") %>% show_all()

cat("\nPassing", MIN_CHECKS, "of", N_CHECKS, ":",
    sum(comprehension$n_ok >= MIN_CHECKS), "of", nrow(comprehension), "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: exclusions
age_df <- read_csv(AGE_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(participant_id = normalize_pid(participant_id),
            age = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(age))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(age))

trials_per_domain <- children %>%
  distinct(participant_id, category, trial) %>%
  count(participant_id, category, name = "n_trials")

enrolled <- tibble(participant_id = sort(unique(children$participant_id))) %>%
  left_join(age_df, by = "participant_id") %>%
  left_join(comprehension, by = "participant_id") %>%
  mutate(
    reason = case_when(
      is.na(age)                              ~ "no recorded age",
      age < AGE_MIN | age >= AGE_MAX          ~ "age outside 4-8",
      is.na(n_ok)                             ~ "no scorable practice trial",
      APPLY_COMPREHENSION & n_ok < MIN_CHECKS ~ "failed comprehension",
      TRUE                                    ~ "included"),
    included = reason == "included")

enrolled %>% count(reason, name = "children") %>%
  arrange(desc(children)) %>% show_all()

keep <- enrolled %>% filter(included) %>% select(participant_id)

# Drops the domain, not the child.
usable_domains <- trials_per_domain %>%
  semi_join(keep, by = "participant_id") %>%
  filter(n_trials >= MIN_TRIALS)

fp <- children %>%
  filter(!is.na(category), category %in% DOMAINS) %>%
  semi_join(usable_domains, by = c("participant_id", "category")) %>%
  inner_join(age_df, by = "participant_id") %>%
  add_age_bins()

tibble(n_children = n_distinct(fp$participant_id),
       n_child_domains = nrow(distinct(fp, participant_id, category))) %>%
  show_all()
```

```{r}
#| label: sample
age_df %>%
  semi_join(distinct(fp, participant_id), by = "participant_id") %>%
  summarise(n = n(), mean = round(mean(age), 2), sd = round(sd(age), 2),
            min = round(min(age), 2), max = round(max(age), 2)) %>%
  show_all()

fp %>%
  distinct(participant_id, age_bin, category) %>%
  count(age_bin, category) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = category, values_from = n) %>%
  arrange(age_bin) %>% show_all()
```

# Adults

```{r}
#| label: load-adults
adults <- load_placements(ADULT_DIR, "adult", normalize_ids = FALSE,
                          use_category_order = TRUE)
adult_raw <- attr(adults, "raw")

tibble(n_adults = n_distinct(adults$participant_id),
       domains = paste(sort(unique(na.omit(adults$category))),
                       collapse = ", ")) %>% show_all()

# Distances are raw pixels, so both groups must have used the same arena.
bind_rows(mutate(describe_geometry(infer_geometry(children)), who = "children"),
          mutate(describe_geometry(infer_geometry(adults)), who = "adults")) %>%
  select(who, everything()) %>% show_all()

# Domain from category_order against domain from the photographs. Expect none.
disagree <- attr(adults, "category_disagreement")
if (is.null(disagree) || !nrow(disagree)) {
  cat("Block-to-domain mapping agrees with the photographs in every trial.\n")
} else {
  show_all(disagree)
}

adults <- filter(adults, !is.na(category), category %in% DOMAINS)
```

```{r}
#| label: screen-adults
# Adults: hammers, teddy bears and a block. All five scored, threshold four.
adult_compr <- score_comprehension(adult_raw,
                                   acceptable = PRACTICE_ACCEPTABLE_ADULT)

if (nrow(adult_compr)) {
  adult_compr %>% count(n_ok, name = "adults") %>% show_all()
  failing <- adult_compr %>%
    filter(n_ok < MIN_CHECKS_ADULT) %>% pull(participant_id)
} else {
  cat("No scorable adult practice trial.\n")
  failing <- character(0)
}

cat("\nBelow", MIN_CHECKS_ADULT, "of", N_CHECKS_ADULT, ":", length(failing),
    "of", n_distinct(adults$participant_id), "\n")

if (APPLY_ADULT_COMPREHENSION && length(failing)) {
  adults <- filter(adults, !participant_id %in% failing)
  cat("Dropped.", n_distinct(adults$participant_id), "adults remain.\n")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: adult-reference
adult_pdv <- participant_dist_vecs(adults)

# Mean arrangement across adults, each normalised first so all count equally.
adult_ref <- adult_pdv %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(lengths(dvec)) == 1) %>%
  summarise(n_adults = n(),
            ref = list(reduce(map(dvec, norm_vec), `+`) / length(dvec)),
            ref_raw = list(reduce(dvec, `+`) / length(dvec)),
            concepts = list(first(concepts)), .groups = "drop")

# How far normalising moved the reference.
adult_ref %>%
  mutate(r_norm_vs_raw = round(map2_dbl(ref, ref_raw,
                                        ~ cor(.x, .y, method = "spearman")), 4)) %>%
  select(category, n_adults, r_norm_vs_raw) %>% show_all()

# Spread of how much of the arena adults used.
adult_pdv %>%
  mutate(scale = map_dbl(dvec, mean)) %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarise(min_scale = round(min(scale)), median_scale = round(median(scale)),
            max_scale = round(max(scale)),
            max_over_min = round(max(scale) / min(scale), 2),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  show_all()

adult_ref <- select(adult_ref, -ref_raw)

#   pairwise  two adults against each other
#   loo       one adult against the mean of the others
adult_agreement <- adult_pdv %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarise(
    n_adults = n(),
    pairwise = mean(combn(length(dvec), 2, function(ix)
      cor(dvec[[ix[1]]], dvec[[ix[2]]], method = "spearman"))),
    loo = {
      tot <- reduce(dvec, `+`); k <- length(dvec)
      mean(map_dbl(seq_len(k), ~ cor(dvec[[.x]], (tot - dvec[[.x]]) / (k - 1),
                                     method = "spearman")))
    },
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)),
         category = fct_domain(category)) %>%
  arrange(category)

show_all(adult_agreement)
```

```{r}
#| label: adult-consistency
# Adults did the same two-trial design, so the same measure applies.
adult_consistency <- compute_consistency(adults)

adult_consistency %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarise(adults = sum(!is.na(consistency)),
            mean_r = round(mean(consistency, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
            ceiling = round(ceiling_from(mean(consistency, na.rm = TRUE)), 3),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(category = fct_domain(category)) %>%
  arrange(category) %>% show_all()
```

```{r}
#| label: adult-rdm-long
# Flat form for the model-comparison file, which joins on concept names.
adult_rdm_long <- adult_ref %>%
  mutate(rows = map2(concepts, ref, ~ mutate(pair_labels(.x), distance = .y))) %>%
  select(domain = category, n_adults, rows) %>%
  unnest(rows)

verify_pair_order(adult_rdm_long)
adult_rdm_long %>% count(domain, name = "pairs") %>% show_all()
```

# Save

```{r}
#| label: save
analysis_sample <- list(
  children = fp,
  consistency = compute_consistency(fp),
  age = age_df,
  adults = adults,
  adult_ref = adult_ref,
  adult_rdm = adult_rdm_long,
  adult_agreement = adult_agreement,
  adult_consistency = adult_consistency,
  audit = enrolled,
  config = list(domains = DOMAINS, AGE_MIN = AGE_MIN, AGE_MAX = AGE_MAX,
                MIN_CHECKS = MIN_CHECKS, MIN_TRIALS = MIN_TRIALS,
                MIN_BIN_N = MIN_BIN_N,
                n_children = n_distinct(fp$participant_id),
                built = Sys.time()))

saveRDS(analysis_sample, "analysis_sample.rds")
write_csv(enrolled, "exclusion_audit.csv")

# The list of every image, read by the model scripts in models/.
fp %>%
  distinct(category, base_name, exemplar, picture_set, image_name) %>%
  arrange(category, base_name, exemplar) %>%
  write_csv("concept_inventory.csv")

str(analysis_sample$config, max.level = 1)
```
